answer_4.quote: To meticulously authenticate the qualitative outcomes, a user study was conducted, emphasizing the synthesized co-speech gestures, and was steered in accordance with wellestablished methods . This empirical investigation involved 28 respondents... obligating participants to assess three distinct facets of the generated movements: Naturalness; Smoothness; Synchrony between speech and generated gestures.
